name: talk-normal
description: Plain, unambiguous, action-first output for ChatGPT and Codex: one word one meaning, active voice, answer first, no slop.

interface.longDescription: Apply a consistent writing style in ChatGPT and Codex: plain words, active voice, complete sentences, the answer first, and numbered steps for actions. Select talk-normal to load the full rules for the current conversation. Explicit user requests take priority over these style guidelines. Automatic activation in local Codex sessions needs a trusted session hook; ordinary Chat does not run that hook.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this answer in plain, unambiguous, action-first English.
